python3 -c "
import subprocess, re
r = subprocess.run(['pdftotext', 'main.pdf', '-'], capture_output=True, text=True)
text = r.stdout
lines = text.split('\n')
ref_page = None
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if line.strip().startswith('References') and len(line.strip()) < 20:
        # find the page by counting form feeds before this line
        ref_page = text[:text.index(line)].count('\x0c') + 1
        break
print(f'References start on page {ref_page}')
print(f'Body pages: {ref_page - 1}')
"
